morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic cluster faces severe propane cost shock and plunging exports amid selective large-player recovery.
what_changed: Propane gas prices surged by Rs 7,300 per tonne ahead of Diwali, creating a severe input-cost shock for Morbi manufacturers.
Indian ceramic tile export volumes dropped steeply by 46% during April-July 2026, with a weak full-year FY27 outlook.
Varmora Granito reported a 498% jump in H1 profit driven by premium tile margins.
stress_signals: Propane prices spiked by Rs 7,300 per tonne ahead of Diwali, threatening operating margins [7b1fa98f465f].
Export volumes fell 46% between April and July 2026, signaling prolonged weakness in overseas demand [434975bd08e0].
A Morbi manufacturer faced a fraud loss of Rs 44.74 lakh after a credit buyer defaulted and became unreachable [29ed75c6450d].
improvement_signals: Varmora Granito's financial results indicate a broader ceramic tile industry recovery, led by premium tile margins [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c].
what_to_watch: Monitor sustainability of high propane prices post-Diwali and pass-through capability of MSMEs.
Track export order flows and realization trends for non-branded tile manufacturers.
Scrutinize credit sales terms and debtor aging reports to prevent buyer fraud and payment defaults.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces liquidity stress and labour disputes alongside strategic technical textile diversification.
what_changed: Surat textile units began producing defence fabrics for the Indian Army.
A 50% raw material cost spike prompted planned month-long loom shutdowns affecting 75,000 workers.
Diamond units reported pre-Diwali payment defaults and unpaid worker wages.
stress_signals: Diamond unit and trader defaults ahead of Diwali threatening worker livelihoods and pending salaries exceeding ₹20 lakh [8f729a2b282e, 402ab705574d, 698c779932f2].
Three-month-long labour dispute and ongoing agitation in the embroidery sector disrupting job-work cash inflows [8a31a5a2c20c, 442c4ff911f8, e7921383cbb7].
Textile market slump driven by a 50% raw material cost jump causing month-long loom shutdowns for 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6].
Operational disruptions from eight-hour power cuts and a reduction in Diwali market lighting due to an electricity crisis [5ae803461fe0, 167f80ff6cdc].
improvement_signals: Textile manufacturers commenced production of advanced defence fabrics for the Indian Army [4966bee026d8, 0f163b499572].
Textile sector eyeing export growth opportunities via the India-New Zealand FTA [8e92d85d894d].
ICA-GemLab is set to open its first Indian laboratory in Surat to provide testing services [26bd1ecd549c].
what_to_watch: Resolution of embroidery sector labour disputes and wage clearance status ahead of Diwali.
Account-level debt servicing and cash flow health for weaving and diamond units impacted by wage defaults and power cuts.
Developments regarding the upcoming state or central textile policy announcements and specific incentive structures.
